hypothesis: Explicit loop-trip counts may explain instruction paths better than total pair counts. This candidate separates full-vector iterations, scalar remainder iterations, per-row work, and key/value preparation.

pcvs.name: full_key_vectors
pcvs.rationale: Directly counts complete 16-element key-vector iterations instead of requiring their reconstruction from total pairs and remainders.

pcvs.name: scalar_key_elements
pcvs.rationale: Counts remaining key elements processed for each query row.

pcvs.name: key_value_elements
pcvs.rationale: Tracks key/value preparation independently of query-row processing.
